title: Measure one leaf with paired timing
objective: Estimate one candidate/reference leaf ratio while cancelling common-mode clock, cache, and temperature drift.
preconditions: Frozen inputs and a pinned GPU
steps: Warm up at least 8 times and discard the first retained internal pair
Collect at least 10 adjacent order-balanced R/C,C/R pairs
Gate on paired p10 and p90 ratios while retaining raw pairs and legacy unpaired summaries
If either side spreads above 1.25x, retry once with 3x pairs; continued spread means no verdict
Record clocks, power, temperature, and reject physical reward above 1.0

acceptance.pass: Paired p10 crosses the declared target, p90 shows no regression, and timing is stable.
acceptance.no_win: The stable paired gate is not met.
acceptance.invalid: Continued instability or physical reward above 1.0.

stop_rule: Do not rank independent candidate and reference medians when paired samples are available.
origin_evidence: Independent quantiles hid real DSA ratios during 2.1-4.7x process drift; paired ratios cancelled it.
